lines.zh: 我每一步都掉糖渣，猎人顺着找过来。
lines.en: Each step sheds crumbs; hunters follow the trail.

lines.zh: 我腿短，可我一步也不肯少走。
lines.en: My legs are short, yet I refuse to skip a step.

lines.zh: 糖霜做的笑脸，走多久都不会变形。
lines.en: My icing smile holds its shape however far I walk.

lines.zh: 脚下的软糖陷进我的重量里。
lines.en: The gummy ground sinks under my weight.

lines.zh: 我沿着曲奇路走，那是我自己撒的。
lines.en: I walk the cookie path I scattered myself.

lines.zh: 别看我笨重，我能追你一整天。
lines.en: Do not mistake my bulk; I can chase you all day.

lines.zh: 关节是硬糖做的，走起来咯咯响。
lines.en: Hard candy joints click with every step I take.

lines.zh: 我朝你走近时，会先摆出好人的样子。
lines.en: As I approach, I put on my friendly face first.

lines.zh: 走慢一点，让人以为我很温顺。
lines.en: I walk slowly so people think I am gentle.

lines.zh: 我的脚印是甜的，这不是好事。
lines.en: My footprints are sweet, and that is no good.

lines.zh: 我在树后绕了半圈，只为换个方向。
lines.en: I loop behind the tree just to change my angle.

lines.zh: 走着走着，我忘了刚才要追谁。
lines.en: Halfway there I forget who I was chasing.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，看起来更像点心。
lines.en: Standing still, I look even more like a snack.

lines.zh: 糖霜在太阳下变软，我的笑有点垮。
lines.en: The sun softens my icing and my smile sags.

lines.zh: 我数着身上的葡萄干，一共十七颗。
lines.en: I count the raisins on my body: seventeen.

lines.zh: 有只鸟在看我，我装作没发现。
lines.en: A bird is watching me; I pretend not to notice.

lines.zh: 这地方太甜了，连空气都黏牙。
lines.en: This place is so sweet the air sticks to teeth.

lines.zh: 我在等一个觉得我可爱的人。
lines.en: I am waiting for someone who finds me cute.

lines.zh: 关节里的糖浆一凉就硬住了。
lines.en: The syrup in my joints hardens when it cools.

lines.zh: 我闻到自己身上的姜味，有点饿。
lines.en: I smell my own ginger and feel a little hungry.

lines.zh: 手臂抬起来就放不下去，卡住了。
lines.en: My arm went up and will not come down; stuck.

lines.zh: 地板裂缝里还有去年的糖粒。
lines.en: There are still last year's sugar grains in the cracks.

lines.zh: 你好，我看起来很友善，对吧。
lines.en: Hello there. I look quite friendly, do I not?

lines.zh: 你退后了，我的笑还得再甜一点。
lines.en: You stepped back; I must sweeten my smile further.

lines.zh: 我盯着你时，眼睛其实不会动。
lines.en: When I stare at you, my eyes do not actually move.

lines.zh: 你身上有面粉味，你也是烤出来的？
lines.en: You smell of flour; were you baked too?

lines.zh: 我歪头，糖霜从耳朵上掉下来。
lines.en: I tilt my head and icing slides off my ear.

lines.zh: 别信这张脸，它是用糖画出来的。
lines.en: Do not trust this face; it is drawn in sugar.

lines.zh: 你握剑的手在抖，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: The hand on your sword is shaking; I see it clearly.

lines.zh: 我慢慢靠近，这样看起来不像威胁。
lines.en: I come closer slowly so I do not look threatening.

lines.zh: 你身上没有姜味，可惜了。
lines.en: You have no ginger smell on you; a pity.

lines.zh: 我再走近一步，你就该跑了。
lines.en: One more step from me and you should run.

lines.zh: 糖壳掉了，露出里面深色的姜。
lines.en: My sugar shell falls away, revealing dark ginger beneath.

lines.zh: 疼是疼，可我不会因此停下。
lines.en: It hurts, but it will not make me stop.

lines.zh: 你打碎的是我的手指，不是我的手。
lines.en: You broke my finger, not my hand.

lines.zh: 这一下让我掉了三颗葡萄干。
lines.en: That blow knocked off three of my raisins.

lines.zh: 别停手，我正想看看里面什么样。
lines.en: Do not stop; I want to see what is inside.

lines.zh: 我的胸口裂了，但笑还挂着。
lines.en: My chest is split, but the smile still hangs there.

lines.zh: 你打断了糖霜，糖霜又粘回来。
lines.en: You break the icing, and the icing sticks back.

lines.zh: 我在后退，可我的眼睛没离开你。
lines.en: I fall back, but my eyes never leave you.

lines.zh: 打碎我的时候，你闻到姜味了吧。
lines.en: As you break me, you smell the ginger, do you not?

lines.zh: 疼过之后，我会把这一下还回去。
lines.en: Once the pain passes, I will return that blow.

lines.zh: 糖？我不缺糖，我缺一顿饭。
lines.en: Sugar? I am not short of sugar; I am short of a meal.

lines.zh: 你把甜食递过来，手就离我太近了。
lines.en: You offer sweets, and your hand comes too close.

lines.zh: 我装出想吃的样子，你也信了。
lines.en: I pretend to want it, and you believe me.

lines.zh: 别把手伸进来，我会连手一起咬。
lines.en: Do not reach in; I will bite the hand too.

lines.zh: 这点碎糖，还不够垫我的牙缝。
lines.en: These crumbs would not even fill my teeth.

lines.zh: 香味让我往前一步，只一步。
lines.en: The smell pulls me forward one step, only one.

lines.zh: 你以为在喂我，其实在量距离。
lines.en: You think you are feeding me; you are measuring distance.

lines.zh: 我偏过头，装作用不上这东西。
lines.en: I turn my head, pretending I have no use for it.

lines.zh: 糖能引来小孩，这才是它的用处。
lines.en: Sugar lures children; that is what it is really for.

lines.zh: 拿开，我要的是你，不是饼干。
lines.en: Move it away; I want you, not the biscuit.

lines.zh: 撞上了，你身上沾了一片糖霜。
lines.en: We bumped; there is icing on you now.

lines.zh: 我这么重，你还敢站在路中间。
lines.en: I am this heavy, and you stand in my path.

lines.zh: 让一让，我停不下来，糖会卡住关节。
lines.en: Move; I cannot stop, sugar jams my joints.

lines.zh: 这一下算打招呼，下次算别的。
lines.en: That bump was a greeting; next time it counts.

lines.zh: 我的手臂撞你一下，够你疼一阵。
lines.en: One arm swing from me aches for a while.

lines.zh: 你被撞得后退，我顺势贴近。
lines.en: You stagger back and I close the gap.

lines.zh: 别躲在树后，我会把树也撞开。
lines.en: Do not hide behind the tree; I will bump that too.

lines.zh: 糖渣掉进我们中间，像一道界线。
lines.en: Crumbs fall between us like a boundary line.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我身上的葡萄干晃了晃。
lines.en: The impact rattles the raisins on my chest.

lines.zh: 我不是没看见你，我是不打算让。
lines.en: I saw you; I simply had no plan to yield.

lines.zh: 我把最完整的那颗糖留给你。
lines.en: I saved the most perfect candy for you.

lines.zh: 别怕我的手，它只会把糖捏碎。
lines.en: Do not fear my hands; they only crush sugar.

lines.zh: 我们一起站着，像一对摆好的点心。
lines.en: We stand together like a matched pair of pastries.

lines.zh: 我把笑脸转给你，那是真心的。
lines.en: I turn my smile toward you; this one is real.

lines.zh: 肩膀靠一下，糖霜会粘在一起。
lines.en: Lean on me and our icing will stick.

lines.zh: 我们守同一块糖地，谁也别进来。
lines.en: We guard the same sugar patch; nobody else enters.

lines.zh: 我用姜味记住你，比看脸可靠。
lines.en: I remember you by ginger smell, more reliable than faces.

lines.zh: 等天冷了，我们靠在一起就不会硬。
lines.en: When it grows cold we lean together and stay soft.

lines.zh: 我这副身板，站你旁边正好挡风。
lines.en: This frame of mine blocks the wind beside you.

lines.zh: 别走太远，糖渣会断的。
lines.en: Do not go far; the crumb trail will break.

lines.zh: 地上那块姜饼，是我掉的。
lines.en: That gingerbread on the ground came off me.

lines.zh: 我弯下腰去捡，腰响了一声。
lines.en: I bend to pick it up and my waist creaks.

lines.zh: 捡糖的时候最容易被偷袭。
lines.en: Grabbing sugar is when I am easiest to ambush.

lines.zh: 这块曲奇归我，谁先碰到算谁的。
lines.en: This cookie is mine; whoever touches first owns it.

lines.zh: 我捡起一颗葡萄干，按回胸口。
lines.en: I pick up a raisin and press it back to my chest.

lines.zh: 太重了，我用两只手抱着走。
lines.en: Too heavy; I carry it in both hands.

lines.zh: 别弯腰，你一低头我就动手。
lines.en: Do not bend down; the moment you do, I move.

lines.zh: 我藏东西的地方，全是糖纸。
lines.en: My hiding place is full of candy wrappers.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，比拿在手里的好抢。
lines.en: Dropped things are easier to take than held ones.

lines.zh: 我捡完这块，再来处理你。
lines.en: Once I have this, I will deal with you.

lines.zh: 我选你了，因为你看起来不设防。
lines.en: I chose you because you look unguarded.

lines.zh: 你先笑了一下，我就知道好办。
lines.en: You smiled first, and I knew this would be easy.

lines.zh: 别跑向空旷处，那里我追得快。
lines.en: Do not run for open ground; I chase faster there.

lines.zh: 我记得你的脚步，碎而急。
lines.en: I remember your steps: quick and small.

lines.zh: 你手里的糖，把方向指给我了。
lines.en: The sugar in your hand points me your way.

lines.zh: 追上你之前，我会一直笑着。
lines.en: I will keep smiling until I catch you.

lines.zh: 我不急，糖做的东西有的是时间。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; sugar things have all the time.

lines.zh: 你的同伴走了，现在只剩你。
lines.en: Your companion left; now there is only you.

lines.zh: 我压低肩膀，这是要冲的信号。
lines.en: I drop my shoulder; that is the signal to charge.

lines.zh: 隔着糖雾我也认得你的轮廓。
lines.en: Even through sugar mist I know your outline.

lines.zh: 别以为躲进糖林就安全了。
lines.en: Do not think the candy woods keep you safe.

lines.zh: 我挑了最慢的那个，就是你。
lines.en: I picked the slowest one, and that is you.

lines.zh: 我的影子先到你脚边，抬头吧。
lines.en: My shadow reaches your feet first; look up.

lines.zh: 这一路的糖渣，都是我引你来的。
lines.en: Every crumb along this path led you to me.

lines.zh: 你在糖林里找路，我就在路边。
lines.en: You look for a path; I am beside it.

lines.zh: 你手里那根拐杖是糖做的吗？
lines.en: Is that cane made of sugar too?

lines.zh: 我在你三步之外，再近就要动手。
lines.en: I stand three steps away; closer starts the violence.

lines.zh: 你往左，我就往右，路只有一条。
lines.en: You go left, I go right; there is one road.

lines.zh: 我把手背在身后，看起来无害。
lines.en: I put my hands behind my back to look harmless.

lines.zh: 糖浆在我指缝里滴，慢慢滴。
lines.en: Syrup drips between my fingers, slowly.

lines.zh: 别看我的笑，看我的脚。
lines.en: Do not watch my smile; watch my feet.

lines.zh: 我等你的剑先落下来。
lines.en: I wait for your sword to fall first.

lines.zh: 你退到墙角，我就不用追了。
lines.en: Back yourself into the corner and I need not chase.

lines.zh: 这块地是糖做的，踩重了会塌。
lines.en: This ground is sugar; step hard and it caves.

lines.zh: 我数你的呼吸，数到三。
lines.en: I count your breaths, up to three.

lines.zh: 你把盾举高了，脖子就露出来。
lines.en: You raise the shield and your neck shows.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊了你反而会跑。
lines.en: I keep quiet; a shout would only send you running.

lines.zh: 再退一步，你背后就是糖刺。
lines.en: One more step back and the sugar thorns take you.

lines.zh: 我把重心挪到前脚，你该懂了。
lines.en: I shift my weight forward; you should understand.

lines.zh: 姜味越来越近，那是我。
lines.en: The ginger smell grows stronger; that is me.

lines.zh: 我往后退一步，你就会跟上来。
lines.en: One step back and you follow.

lines.zh: 你的脚下全是糖渣，很滑。
lines.en: Sugar crumbs underfoot; mind your step.

lines.zh: 我等糖果风把味道吹给你。
lines.en: I let the candy wind carry my smell.

lines.zh: 你换了只手拿剑，破绽变了。
lines.en: You switched sword hands; the gap moved.

lines.zh: 我把糖霜抹在手上，会更黏。
lines.en: Frosting on my fists makes them stick.

lines.zh: 你在桥中间，两边都是糖浆。
lines.en: Mid-bridge, syrup on both sides.

lines.zh: 我这一拳，用的是烤炉给的全部力气。
lines.en: This punch uses every bit of strength the oven gave me.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡住了糖霜，挡不住重量。
lines.en: Your armor stops the icing, not the weight.

lines.zh: 打中之后，我的指节碎了半颗。
lines.en: After the hit, half a knuckle breaks off.

lines.zh: 别指望我累了，我不喘气。
lines.en: Do not wait for me to tire; I do not breathe.

lines.zh: 这一下是给那些笑我可爱的人。
lines.en: This one is for everyone who called me cute.

lines.zh: 我的拳头是硬糖，砸下去会黏住。
lines.en: My fist is hard candy; it sticks where it lands.

lines.zh: 你听到的碎裂声，是我的手腕。
lines.en: That cracking sound is my wrist, not yours.

lines.zh: 我打得很重，因为我只有这一招。
lines.en: I hit hard because it is the only move I have.

lines.zh: 你的剑划开我，糖浆流了一手。
lines.en: Your sword opens me and syrup runs down my arm.

lines.zh: 挨打的人会记住姜的味道。
lines.en: Whoever takes this hit remembers the taste of ginger.

lines.zh: 我再抬一次手，这次更高。
lines.en: I raise my arm again, and higher this time.

lines.zh: 你以为我要抱你，其实不是。
lines.en: You think I mean to hug you; I do not.

lines.zh: 打完这一拳，我的笑还是没变。
lines.en: After the punch my smile still has not changed.

lines.zh: 碎的是你，我的糖只是掉了一点。
lines.en: You break; I only lose a little sugar.

lines.zh: 这一拳砸在你的护腕上，粘住了。
lines.en: A fist to your bracer, and it sticks.

lines.zh: 我从侧面撞你，糖屑飞了一脸。
lines.en: I ram you sideways, crumbs in your face.

lines.zh: 你砍下我一只手，我照样往前。
lines.en: Take my hand; I still come on.

lines.zh: 我抬腿踢你，膝盖硬得像砖。
lines.en: My knee kicks hard as brick.

lines.zh: 你退到糖刺丛，我不用再追。
lines.en: Back into the sugar thorns; no chase needed.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但你记住了味道。
lines.en: Not heavy, but you will remember the taste.

lines.zh: 我从糖块里被推出来，身上还热。
lines.en: I am pushed out of the sugar block, still warm.

lines.zh: 刚烤好就站着，脚底还软。
lines.en: Fresh from the oven, my soles are still soft.

lines.zh: 这里的味道和我身上的很像。
lines.en: This place smells much like my own body.

lines.zh: 我睁眼，先学会的是笑。
lines.en: I open my eyes and learn to smile first.

lines.zh: 有谁把我放在这条路上，我记不清。
lines.en: Someone set me on this path; I cannot recall who.

lines.zh: 糖树下面站着一群和我一样的东西。
lines.en: Under the candy tree stands a crowd like me.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，糖粉落了一地。
lines.en: I shake myself and powder falls everywhere.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我身上的姜味散开很远。
lines.en: The wind carries my ginger smell a long way.

lines.zh: 刚出生就觉得饿，这不太对。
lines.en: I am hungry the moment I exist; that seems wrong.

lines.zh: 我试着走第一步，脚印是甜的。
lines.en: My first step leaves a sweet footprint.

lines.zh: 头顶糖霜还没干，滴进我的眼睛。
lines.en: The icing above has not dried and drips in my eye.

lines.zh: 我先学会了笑，再学会了追。
lines.en: I learned to smile before I learned to chase.

lines.zh: 烤炉养大的，火却能烧穿糖壳。
lines.en: The oven raised me, yet fire burns through my shell.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上滚下去，掉了半个头。
lines.en: I roll off the step and lose half my head.

lines.zh: 水把我的糖霜冲成一条线。
lines.en: Water washes my icing away in a thin line.

lines.zh: 炸得我胸口凹进去，糖浆往外冒。
lines.en: The blast dents my chest and syrup seeps out.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我肩上，像一根牙签。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my shoulder like a toothpick.

lines.zh: 法术让我的糖霜自己往下滑。
lines.en: The spell makes my icing slide off by itself.

lines.zh: 饿久了，我的关节会一粒粒松。
lines.en: Starved long enough, my joints loosen one by one.

lines.zh: 雷下来，我身上一半成了焦糖。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and half of me turns to caramel.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有地面，糖也没用。
lines.en: No ground in the void, and sugar does not help.
